# Size Classification

## Small Size

- use for probe entries
- low confidence or early structure
- stop-loss amount should be easy to ignore operationally

## Medium Size

- standard production entry
- trend, structure, and RR all aligned
- default size class when no exceptional edge exists

## Large Size

- only for high-conviction, high-confluence setups
- requires strongest monitoring discipline
- never use simply because leverage allows it

## Decision Rule

- classify by planned stop-loss loss in USDT and account %
- then confirm with liquidity, volatility, and slippage
- if sizing conflicts with exchange minimums, downgrade or skip
